candidates.statement: Payment service shows p95 latency of 1600ms with error_rate 0.004 while gateway, order, and inventory each report p95 71ms and error_rate 0.0014, indicating payment is the latency-degraded downstream dependency driving checkout latency and errors.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-internal traces, dependency timeouts, or deployment facts; payment db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts are 0, so the latency source within payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Only payment deviates: p95 1600ms and error_rate 0.004 versus 71ms/0.0014 on gateway, order, and inventory, with no pool waiters or dependency timeouts anywhere. This supports a bounded downstream-latency candidate at payment; internal cause remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service internal latency breakdown (spans, dependency calls) to localize the 1600ms p95 source
Checkout-to-payment call path traces confirming payment latency propagates to checkout errors
